en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting the elaborate Gothic façade and large pointed-arch window of a church or cathedral entrance, framed by trees, wrought-iron fencing, a small fountain, and a streetlamp in the foreground. The roof behind is steep and covered with small dormer windows. Printed red text at the top reads "Freiberg i. S Goldene Pforte," indicating the subject. Additional vertical publisher text appears along the right edge.
